name.zh: 受 Goniophyllum 启发的四盖珊瑚

description.en: A softly rounded pyramidal cup with four open triangular lids.
description.zh: 柔和方锥杯体与四片张开的三角盖。

sources.title: Structural-functional aspects in the evolution of operculate corals (Rugosa)
sources.supports: Calceola slipper shape and single operculum; Goniophyllum pyramidal shape and multiple lids; reconstructed soft bodies are hypotheses.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.use: consulted-only; no source media, mesh or texture incorporated
sources.rights_note: No third-party license grant inferred from consultation.

reconstruction_notes.en: Palette, exact dimensions, open-lid/arm pose, counts of minor repeated parts and soft tissue are artistic choices. No copied media, mesh or texture. Cross-period catalogue; no coexistence claim.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 配色、精确尺寸、开盖/腕姿势、细小重复结构数量及软组织均属美术选择。无第三方网格、图片或贴图；跨时代目录，不主张同域共存。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
